digest.component_or_area: LLM operations and operation config composition
propositions: LLMConfig.from_env() is called independently at 16 production sites across _mcp_llm.py, _lib_ops.py, and reconciler, bypassing centralized snapshot composition and gate config scoping.

The shadow resolution machinery (emit_shadow_snapshot, _shadow, SHADOW_ENV) was retained as a diagnostic aid but now blocks retiring ambient resolution patterns; all 16 call sites must migrate to authoritative snapshot/context binding before deletion.

LLM operations must compose exactly one snapshot/context per public entry point (review_code, verify_completion, review_plan, scan_epics_for_spec, run_workflow) and thread it through nested gate/workflow steps so subcalls inherit policy without re-resolving environment.

The new LLM config composer must fail fast on missing/conflicting auth or provider resolution, unlike the general operation snapshot composer which swallows errors; these are independent compositions with different failure contracts.

Four existing test modules assert on shadow symbols directly and must be updated in lockstep with deletion; a new parity test suite must verify compose-once semantics, value equivalence, and metamorphic/failure-edge behavior across multi-step runs.
